_how_to_edit: Hand-entered dashboard info. Edit values here; no code changes needed.
Dates use YYYY-MM-DD and are read as Eastern Time calendar dates.
ratings[].rating: use TBD, Toss-up, or Solid/Likely/Lean/Tilt followed by R or D (e.g. "Lean R"). as_of is the date you checked it.
polling.average: set to null when there are no polls, or fill in e.g. {"kiggans": 47.5, "luria": 45.0} plus source and as_of.
polling.polls: optional list of individual polls, e.g. {"pollster": "Name", "dates": "Oct 1-4", "sample": "600 LV", "kiggans": 48, "luria": 45, "url": "https://..."}.
key_dates: add, remove or reorder freely; the page sorts them by date.
